Use tiny irregular deeply divided unequal lobes, leaf pairs and slender open architecture. Retain reconstruction uncertainty and minimal basal junction; do not infer roots.
concept_observations.thrombolite-mound: Concept front/reverse/hero personally inspected. Preserve squat coherent mound and integrated cutaway. concept_observations.oncoid-bed: Concept hero/top/reverse personally inspected. Keep distinct grains and3 exposed nuclei but reject overly regular onion rings. concept_observations.caytonia: All concept pixels personally inspected. Reject concept distal egg-like longitudinal slits and strong alternating arrangement. Use broad rounded flattened cupules on near-subopposite pairs; a proximal narrow mouth/lip points back toward attachment. Thin nonwoody axis; no foliage or whole-plant extrapolation.

scientific_scope.eophyllophyton: Selected-axis educational reconstruction, not a measured complete plant. Primary evidence supports small divided leaves and branches; full habit,12 pairs,3D pose, green palette and6cm nominal height are artistic. Pragian Posongchong context belongs to cited fossils, not exhaustive temporal range. Original2013 publisher unavailable; primary text and attributed reproduced fossil plate distinguished.
scientific_scope.thrombolite-mound: Generic geological teaching reconstruction, not a specific measured locality specimen or a literal thin section enlarged into a mound. First-party UGS external mound and microscopic/core fabric support distinct exterior and internal clotted fabric. Teaching cut pattern deliberately enlarged and simplified; macroscopic appearance alone does not establish microbial species or precise biological process. Dimensions/palette/clot pattern artistic.
scientific_scope.oncoid-bed: Generic pedagogical loose oncoid bed, not reconstruction of a measured Hydra bed or a single source locality. UGS primary slab/core pixels support cm-scale shapes and coating/nucleus relationships; Hydra text supports irregular overlapping lamination but its1.8–4.1mm grain dimensions are not imported. Art arrangement,count,color,size and enlarged legibility are explicit; no assertion of a specific organism or unique growth process.
scientific_scope.caytonia: Caytonia reproductive-axis reconstruction only. Leaf genus Sagenopteris and pollen-organ Caytonanthus association is supported by cooccurrence/cuticle evidence but whole-plant organic connections/habit unresolved; no attached leaves or whole-plant claim. Primary official compressed fossils and historic drawings constrain two ranks and recurvature; thickness/pose/palette,12 cupules and nominal5cm axis are artistic. Cupule is not an angiosperm fruit. Visible lip does not assert exact anatomical seed count.
